Monday Night Football is Buffalo at Minnesota, and three games in your league are still open. Allen-tents & Purposes leads McCallyCockin(his butt) 104.80 to 93.36, I Pulled My McCaff leads LetLamarCook 132.96 to 102.08, and Your Mom’s Magic Dick leads NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson 129.14 to 93.48.

Vikings QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) was ruled out for Monday night by coach Kevin O’Connell and is week-to-week, with no IR move planned. Carson Wentz is expected to start and Max Brosmer is the backup. Jauan Jennings (calf) is also out. NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson has the Minnesota defense, and Your Mom’s Magic Dick has Aaron Jones Sr.

Waiver moves since Wednesday: tballsmccall swapped Baker Mayfield for Sam Darnold and Tez Johnson for Drew Lock, Cavemanfsu added Emmett Johnson and Elijah Mitchell, and Bill_Buttlicker added Demarcus Robinson on Sunday.
Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve after thumb surgery and is out at least Weeks 9 through 12. LetLamarCook is 7‑1 and started Patrick Mahomes (16.48) in Week 9.
Only the Steelers and Titans were on bye in Week 9. Check lineups before Thursday.

stories.dek: The first-place team scored 0.0 at quarterback in Week 8 and still won. The bye week takes Tony Pollard next.
body: Lamar Jackson hurt his right thumb on the first play of Baltimore's loss to Buffalo, and the Ravens coach says he needs surgery and goes to IR. He is out at least Weeks 9 through 12. DuvalTiliFall has Patrick Mahomes, who scored 26.44 on the bench Sunday, as the only other quarterback on the roster. Aaron Rodgers was dropped Sunday morning.

LetLamarCook still won Sunday with 105.30 thanks to Pollard, Cook (18.1) and Keenan Allen (13.7). It is first at 7‑1 with 971.14 points.
